# RightNow AI

> YC-backed GPU research lab. We ship the RightNow CUDA editor and Forge kernel agent, and publish AutoMegaKernel, AutoKernel, StreamIndex, Ouroboros, HCLSM, and TIDE on arXiv. Hardware-aware AI, custom agents with skills and MCP support, stable SSH workflows, and a clear model list across cloud and local GPU models.

## Products

- [RightNow Code Editor](https://www.rightnowai.co): AI-powered IDE for CUDA/GPU development with Nsight Compute integration, GPU emulation, multi-LLM support, and first-class Numba, CUDA Tile, and Mojo workflows.
- [Forge Agent](https://www.rightnowai.co/forge): Swarm agent system using 32 parallel Coder+Judge pairs to turn slow PyTorch into fast CUDA/Triton kernels. Up to 14x faster than torch.compile with 100% numerical correctness.

## Research

All papers by Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026 · cs.LG. Full list at [rightnowai.co](https://www.rightnowai.co).

- **AutoMegaKernel: A Statically-Checked Agent Harness for Self-Retargeting Megakernel Synthesis** (arXiv:2606.09682)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Agent harness for synthesizing self-retargeting megakernels for LLM inference, with static checks across the generation loop.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2606.09682

- **AutoKernel: Autonomous GPU Kernel Optimization via Iterative Agent-Driven Search** (arXiv:2603.21331)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Autonomous agent-driven search loop for iteratively optimizing GPU kernels.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21331
  - Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/autokernel

- **StreamIndex: Memory-Bounded Compressed Sparse Attention via Streaming Top-k** (arXiv:2605.02568)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Memory-bounded compressed sparse attention using a streaming top-k index, with a Triton implementation.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2605.02568
  - Code: https://github.com/RightNow-AI/StreamIndex

- **Ouroboros: Dynamic Weight Generation for Recursive Transformers via Input-Conditioned LoRA Modulation** (arXiv:2604.02051)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Dynamic weight generation for recursive transformers through input-conditioned LoRA modulation.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.02051

- **HCLSM: Hierarchical Causal Latent State Machines for Object-Centric World Modeling** (arXiv:2603.29090)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Hierarchical causal latent state machines for object-centric world modeling.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.29090

- **TIDE: Token-Informed Depth Execution for Per-Token Early Exit in LLM Inference** (arXiv:2603.21365)
  - Authors: Jaber Jaber*, Osama Jaber · 2026
  - Token-informed depth execution enabling per-token early exit for more efficient LLM inference.
  - arXiv: https://arxiv.org/abs/2603.21365
